author: Zaki67
quote: I didnt want Grand Paint auto, helping grandmas, having a needy girlfriend as a main story... why even bother having a name GTA at this point. Gaming journalists are marketing employees and it was never as obvious as now. Some say 30fps isnt a problem meanwhile also saying that they needed hours to get used to it. Since when do you have to get used to something that`s "not bad"? And the good ending of the game comes if you are in a good relationship with the girlfriend which means doing all her chores, massaging her feet.... it`s like Sims but for adults. Simpulator. And the protection of protesters and certain groups of people. Big L. Some say, but movies also have less than 30fps - true, but you dont have to aim and shoot at the enemies or drive 200km/h in the move, right? Skipping this game for sure. Too much nudity/corn looking scenes that are unavoidable (in previous gtas you could avoid it, they at least had some clothes). Not for kids, but now for real this time.
